newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's property shares continue to gain ground.
newsitem.headline: Japan's property shares continue to gain ground.

text.p: Shares in construction and real estate shares continued to gain ground on Friday, supported by market hopes for government policies to liquidate land collateralised for non-performing loans, traders said.
At 0101 GMT, shares of Obayashi Corp, a construction firm, were bid-only at 736 yen, compared with Thursday's close of 706 yen.
Shares in Kajima Corp were up 20 yen at 705, with Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd up 60 yen at 1,360 and Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd up 70 yen at 1,460.

On Thursday, property and bank shares rose on a newspaper report that the government may use public funds to buy land formerly owned by failed housing loan firms and other troubled financial institutions.
Shares in those sectors had been dragged down recently by worries over their heavy burden of bad loans.
